source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 10 exercise solved (PDF 232-233), every question with an easy model answer and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 10 (Human Respiratory System) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Kitab MCQs ki answer key nahi deti; har MCQ ka jawab chapter se nikal kar wajah ke saath diya gaya hai. Short sawalon ke jawab mukhtasar aur long sawalon ke poore number wale model jawab hain. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. During inhalation, diaphragm;
(Saans andar lete waqt diaphragm ka kya hota hai?)

options.text: Sukarta hai aur oopar jata hai
Sukarta hai aur neeche jata hai
Dheela hota hai aur oopar jata hai
Dheela hota hai aur neeche jata hai

blocks.explanation: Inhalation (saans andar lena) mein diaphragm contract (sukarna) hota hai, neeche aata hai aur chapta (flat) ho jata hai. Is se thorax (seena) ki jagah barhti hai aur hawa phephron mein aati hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Which part of the respiratory system acts as the respiratory surface?
(Respiratory system ka kaun sa hissa respiratory surface (gas badalne ki jagah) ka kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gas exchange sirf alveoli ki patli, geeli deewaron par hota hai. Larynx, trachea aur bronchi sirf hawa ko aage le jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
3. How many oxygen molecules can attach with a haemoglobin molecule?
(Haemoglobin ke aik molecule ke saath oxygen ke kitne molecules jur sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Haemoglobin mein 4 polypeptide chains aur 4 haem groups hote hain. Har haem ka iron aik O₂ pakarta hai, is liye aik haemoglobin 4 O₂ molecules le ja sakta hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. What is TRUE about respiratory pigments?
(Respiratory pigments ke baare mein kaun si baat SAHI hai?)

options.text: Oxygen ko phephron se tissues tak le jate hain
Oxygen aur carbon dioxide barabar miqdaar mein le jate hain
Kam oxygen aur zyada carbon dioxide le jate hain
Blood ka pH control karte hain

blocks.explanation: Respiratory pigments (jaise haemoglobin) khaas proteins hain jin ka bara kaam oxygen ko phephron se tissues tak le jana hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Which respiratory pigment is found in muscle tissue?
(Muscle tissue mein kaun sa respiratory pigment hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Myoglobin skeletal aur cardiac muscles ka oxygen pakarne wala protein hai; yeh muscles mein oxygen store (jama) karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. What is the maximum amount of air that can be inhaled or exhaled during a respiratory cycle?
(Aik saans ke cycle mein zyada se zyada kitni hawa andar ya bahar ki ja sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: (Chapter se bahar: lung volumes is chapter mein nahi hain.) Vital capacity hawa ki woh zyada se zyada miqdaar hai jo sab se gehri saans lene ke baad poori taaqat se bahar nikali ja sake (taqreeban 4.5-5 litre). Tidal volume aam aik saans ki hawa hai (taqreeban aadha litre).

blocks.prompt:
7. In what form is carbon dioxide primarily transported in the bloodstream?
(Carbon dioxide blood mein zyada tar kis shakal mein jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Taqreeban 72% CO₂ bicarbonate ions (HCO₃⁻) ki shakal mein jati hai; 20% haemoglobin se jur kar aur sirf 8% plasma mein ghul kar.

blocks.prompt:
8. Which of the following treatments is commonly used to manage pulmonary TB?
(Pulmonary TB ke ilaaj ke liye aam tor par kaun sa treatment istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pulmonary TB bacteria (Mycobacterium tuberculosis) se hoti hai. Chapter ke mutabiq is ka ilaaj kai antibiotics hain jo lambe arse (taqreeban 9 mahine) tak baqaidgi se liye jate hain. (d) ke bare mein Kitab ki ghalti dekhein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Do options sahi maane ja sakte hain. Chapter mein ilaaj "multiple antibiotics" (kai antibiotics, mahinon tak baqaidgi se) likha hai, is liye (a) jawab rakha gaya. Magar (d) bhi tibbi zaban mein durust hai: TB ka ilaaj "anti-TB chemotherapy" kehlata hai, aur is ki kuch dawaein (isoniazid, pyrazinamide, ethambutol) synthetic chemotherapeutic drugs (lab mein bani dawaein) hain, asal maani mein antibiotics nahi. Cough syrup (b) sirf khansi ki alamat kam karta hai aur surgery (c) aam ilaaj nahi. Exam mein chapter wala jawab (a) Antibiotics likhein.

blocks.prompt:
9. Which of the following is a common cause of pneumonia?
(Pneumonia ki aam wajah kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pneumonia zyada tar bacteria (khaas tor par Streptococcus pneumoniae) ya viruses se, aur kabhi kabhi fungi se hota hai. Is liye teenon wajahein sahi hain.

blocks.prompt:
10. Emphysema is characterized by:
(Emphysema ki pehchan kya hai?)

options.text: Hawa ki nalion ka tang hona
Phephron ke alveoli ka toot jana

blocks.explanation: Emphysema mein alveoli ki andar wali deewarein toot jati hain, bohat se chhote khanon ki jagah aik bara khana ban jata hai aur gas exchange ki surface kam ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
1. Define respiratory surface and list its properties.
Respiratory surface ki tareef karein aur is ki khoobiyan likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Respiratory surface woh jagah hai jahan mahol aur blood ke darmiyan asal gas exchange diffusion (phailao) se hota hai; insaan mein yeh alveoli hain.
Khoobiyan: geeli aur permeable (guzarne dene wali); patli; khoon ki bharpoor supply; sahara (support) taake band na ho; jism ke andar taake paani na ure; hawa aati jati rahe aur pehle nami (water vapour) se bhar jaye.

blocks.prompt:
2. How nasal cavity functions in filtering the inhaled air?
Nasal cavity (naak ka khana) andar aane wali hawa ko kaise saaf (filter) karti hai?
blocks.explanation:
Naak ke baal aur mucous membrane ka mucus (balgham jaisa chipchipa maadda) hawa ke bare zarrat (dhool, germs) ko pakar lete hain, is se pehle ke hawa andar jaye.
Sath hi surface ke qareeb blood vessels hawa ko garam aur geela (humidify) karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
3. Trace the path of air through different parts of the respiratory system.
Respiratory system ke mukhtalif hisson se hawa ka raasta bataein.
blocks.explanation: Nostrils (nathne) → nasal cavity → pharynx (gala) → larynx (glottis ke raaste) → trachea (saans ki nali) → do primary bronchi → secondary bronchi → tertiary bronchi → bronchioles → terminal bronchioles → alveolar ducts → alveoli (jahan gas exchange hota hai).

blocks.prompt:
4. Describe the structure and function of alveoli.
Alveoli ki banawat aur kaam bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Banawat: alveoli hawa ki nanhi thailiyan hain jo alveolar ducts ke siron par 20-30 ke guchhon mein hoti hain; in ki deewar geeli epithelium sirf 0.1 micrometre moti hoti hai, oopar capillaries ka jaal aur andar surfactant hota hai. Dono phephron mein 70 crore (700 million) tak alveoli hote hain.
Kaam: yahi respiratory surface hain; O₂ hawa se capillaries ke blood mein aur CO₂ blood se alveoli mein diffuse hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. What is the role of diaphragm during inhalation and exhalation?
Saans andar lene aur bahar nikalne mein diaphragm ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation:
Inhalation: diaphragm contract ho kar chapta aur neeche hota hai, thorax ki jagah barhti hai, phephron ka pressure bahar ki hawa se kam ho jata hai aur hawa andar aati hai.
Exhalation: diaphragm relax ho kar dobara gumbad (dome) jaisa ho jata hai, thorax chhota hota hai, phephron ka pressure barh jata hai aur hawa bahar nikalti hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. What the three ways of the transport of carbon dioxide in blood?
(Sahi parhein: What are the three ways ...) Blood mein carbon dioxide le jane ke teen tareeqe kya hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Bicarbonate ions (HCO₃⁻) ki shakal mein plasma mein, taqreeban 72%.
2. Haemoglobin ki globin chains se jur kar, taqreeban 20% (kitab ise carboxyhaemoglobin kehti hai; sahi naam carbaminohaemoglobin hai).
3. Plasma mein ghul kar, taqreeban 8%.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "What the three ways" chhapa hai, "are" reh gaya hai. Sahi: "What are the three ways of the transport of carbon dioxide in blood?"

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: CO₂ jab haemoglobin ke protein (globin) hisse se jurti hai to use carbaminohaemoglobin kehte hain. Carboxyhaemoglobin asal mein carbon monoxide (CO) ke jurne se banta hai (CO poisoning). Exam mein kitab ka lafz likh sakte hain, lekin sahi naam yaad rakhein.

blocks.prompt:
7. What are the advantages of having millions of alveoli rather than a pair of simple balloon-like lungs?
Do saada guubaaron jaise phephron ke bajaye karoron alveoli hone ke kya faide hain?
blocks.explanation:
Karoron chhote alveoli (70 crore tak) diffusion ke liye bohat bari kul surface dete hain, jo isi hajam ke do saada thailon se kahin zyada hai.
Har alveolus ki deewar bohat patli aur capillaries se lipti hoti hai, is liye O₂ aur CO₂ tezi se aur bari miqdaar mein badalti hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misal: aik bara aaloo chheel kar dekhein to chhilka kam hota hai; usi aaloo ke chhote chhote tukre karein to kul chhilka (surface) bohat barh jata hai. Alveoli bhi yahi karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
8. Differentiate between:
• Internal and external respiration
Farq bataein: Internal aur external respiration
blocks.explanation: External respiration hawa aur jism ke darmiyan (phephron mein) gas exchange hai; internal respiration blood aur jism ke cells ke darmiyan (tissues mein).

rows: Mahol se O₂ lena aur CO₂ bahar nikalna (jism ke system ki satah par)
Blood aur tissue cells ke darmiyan gas exchange

Tissues (jism ki capillaries aur cells) mein

Breathing (saans) is ka hissa hai
Cells ki cellular respiration se juri hai

blocks.prompt:
8. Differentiate between:
• Upper and lower respiratory tract
Farq bataein: Upper aur lower respiratory tract
blocks.explanation: Upper tract hawa ko guzarta, saaf, garam aur geela karta hai; lower tract hawa ko phephron tak le jata hai jahan gas exchange hota hai.

Trachea, bronchi, bronchioles aur phephre (alveoli)

Hawa ko upper tract se phephron tak le jata hai

Is ke alveoli mein gas exchange hota hai

Bimariyan: pneumonia, pulmonary TB

blocks.prompt:
8. Differentiate between:
• Bronchi and bronchioles
Farq bataein: Bronchi aur bronchioles
blocks.explanation: Bronchi bari hawa ki nalian hain jin mein cartilage hota hai; bronchioles un ki sab se chhoti shakhein hain jin mein cartilage plates nahi hotin.

Tertiary bronchi ki shakhon se bani bohat chhoti nalian
C-shaped cartilage (primary) ya cartilage plates (secondary)
Cartilage plates nahi hotin
Primary, secondary (baen 2, daen 3) aur tertiary bronchi
Kai dafa batt kar terminal bronchioles banti hain
Hawa ko phephron mein le jati hain
Alveolar ducts aur phir alveoli par khatam hoti hain

blocks.prompt:
8. Differentiate between:
• Haemoglobin and myoglobin
Farq bataein: Haemoglobin aur myoglobin
blocks.explanation: Haemoglobin blood mein oxygen le jata hai; myoglobin muscles mein oxygen store karta hai.

rows: Chaar polypeptide chains (2 α, 2 β)
Aik polypeptide chain (153 amino acids)
Chaar haem groups; chaar O₂ le jata hai
Aik haem group; aik O₂ pakarta hai
Blood (RBCs) mein
Skeletal aur cardiac muscles mein

blocks.prompt:
1. Describe the mechanism of inhalation and exhalation.
Saans andar lene (inhalation) aur bahar nikalne (exhalation) ka tareeqa-e-kaar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Breathing (ventilation) phephron mein hawa ke aane jane ko kehte hain. Phephre khud hawa nahi kheenchte; do qisam ke muscles pressure kam ya zyada kar ke hawa chalate hain: diaphragm (thorax aur pait ke darmiyan gumbad jaisa muscle) aur intercostal muscles (pasliyon ke darmiyan).
Inspiration (saans andar):
1. Diaphragm contract ho kar neeche aata aur chapta hota hai.
2. Sath hi intercostal muscles contract ho kar pasliyon ko oopar uthate hain aur rib cage phail jata hai.
3. Thorax ki jagah barhti hai; visceral aur parietal pleura ke chipke hone ki wajah se phephre bhi phailte hain.
4. Phephron ka pressure bahar ki hawa (atmosphere) se kam ho jata hai, is liye hawa andar aati hai.
Expiration (saans bahar):
1. Phailne se thorax aur phephron mein elastic tension (khinchao) aa jata hai.
2. Diaphragm relax ho kar phir gumbad ban jata hai; intercostal muscles relax hote hain, pasliyan neeche aur rib cage andar ko aata hai.
3. Thorax ki jagah kam hoti hai aur phephre wapas sukarte (recoil) hain.
4. Phephron ka pressure atmosphere se zyada ho jata hai aur hawa bahar nikalti hai.
Control: har saans medulla oblongata ke respiratory centre ke neurons shuru karte hain. Un ke signals se muscles contract (inspiration) hote hain; signals rukne par muscles relax (expiration) hote hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Seringe (syringe) ka piston peeche khenchein to andar jagah barhti hai, pressure girta hai aur hawa andar aati hai; piston aage karein to hawa bahar. Diaphragm aur pasliyan bhi piston ki tarah thorax ki jagah badalte hain.

blocks.prompt:
2. Describe the transport of oxygen through blood.
Blood ke zariye oxygen ki naql-o-harkat (transport) bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Phephron mein loading: alveoli mein O₂ ka partial pressure (sea level par taqreeban 105 mm Hg) O₂ ko pulmonary capillaries mein diffuse karata hai.
2. Blood mein do shaklein:
   - Thori si O₂ plasma mein ghulti hai (zyada se zyada 3 mL fi litre).
   - Zyada tar O₂ RBCs ke haemoglobin se jur kar oxyhaemoglobin (chamakdar surkh) banti hai; is liye blood fi litre taqreeban 200 mL O₂ le jata hai. Phephron se nikalte waqt 97% haemoglobin oxyhaemoglobin hota hai.
3. Tissues mein unloading: capillaries mein oxyhaemoglobin O₂ chhor kar gehra surkh deoxyhaemoglobin ban jata hai. Aaram ki halat mein veins ke blood ka PO₂ 40 mm Hg aur saturation 75% hota hai, yani sirf 22% O₂ tissues ko milti hai; baqi reserve (zakheera) hai (kitab 78% likhti hai, lekin us ke apne hisaab se 75% banta hai).
4. Unloading barhane wale factors:
   - Exercise: muscles zyada O₂ lete hain, PO₂ 20 mm Hg aur saturation 35% ho jati hai, yani 62% (97 - 35) O₂ milti hai.
   - pH ka kam hona (Bohr effect): tissues ki CO₂ blood ka pH kam karti hai, haemoglobin ka O₂ se lagao (affinity) kam hota hai aur O₂ asani se chhoot jati hai.
   - Garmi (temperature) ka barhna: kaam karte muscles ki garmi bhi yahi asar karti hai.
Yeh reserve saans ya dil rukne par 4-5 minute tak zindagi qaim rakhta hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Describe the transport of carbon dioxide through blood.
Blood ke zariye carbon dioxide ka transport bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Tissues mein bani CO₂ ka partial pressure blood se zyada hota hai, is liye woh blood mein aati hai; phephron mein alveoli ka PCO₂ kam hota hai, is liye blood se nikal jati hai. Blood CO₂ ko teen tareeqon se le jata hai:
1. Bicarbonate ions (taqreeban 72%):
   - CO₂ RBCs mein ja kar paani se mil kar carbonic acid banati hai; yeh kaam enzyme carbonic anhydrase karta hai: CO₂ + H₂O → H₂CO₃.
   - H₂CO₃ toot jata hai: H₂CO₃ → H⁺ + HCO₃⁻.
   - H⁺ oxyhaemoglobin se jurta hai aur woh apni O₂ tissue ko de deta hai.
   - HCO₃⁻ RBC se plasma mein jata hai aur badle mein chloride ion (Cl⁻) andar aata hai: chloride shift (Hamburger phenomenon).
   - Bicarbonate plasma ka bara buffer bhi hai jo acid-base balance qaim rakhta hai.
2. Haemoglobin se jur kar (taqreeban 20%): CO₂ haemoglobin ki globin (protein) chains se jurti hai. Kitab ise carboxyhaemoglobin kehti hai; sahi naam carbaminohaemoglobin hai. CO₂ protein hisse se aur O₂ haem ke iron se jurti hai, is liye dono ka muqabla nahi hota.
3. Plasma mein ghul kar (taqreeban 8%).
Phephron mein: alveoli ki hawa ka kam PCO₂ H₂CO₃ ko wapas H₂O aur CO₂ mein badal deta hai; CO₂ alveoli mein ja kar saans ke saath bahar nikal jati hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chloride shift ko aise yaad rakhein: aik manfi (negative) ion bahar gaya (HCO₃⁻) to us ki jagah doosra manfi ion andar aaya (Cl⁻), taake RBC mein charge barabar rahe.

blocks.prompt:
4. Describe the structure and function of haemoglobin.
Haemoglobin ki banawat aur kaam bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Haemoglobin RBCs mein maujood respiratory pigment (protein) hai.
Banawat:
1. Is mein chaar globin polypeptide chains hain: do α chains (har aik mein 141 amino acids) aur do β chains (har aik mein 146 amino acids).
2. Chains aapas mein salt bridges, hydrogen bonds aur hydrophobic effect se juri hoti hain.
3. Har chain mur kar aik jeb (pocket) banati hai jis mein aik haem group baithta hai; yun chaar haem groups hote hain.
4. Haem group mein aik iron ion porphyrin ring mein chaar nitrogen atoms se pakra hota hai (kitab kehti hai nitrogen polypeptide chain ke hain; asal mein yeh porphyrin ring ke hain).
Kaam:
1. Phephron mein (zyada PO₂) har iron aik O₂ pakarta hai, yun aik haemoglobin chaar O₂ le jata hai aur chamakdar surkh oxyhaemoglobin banta hai.
2. Tissues mein (kam PO₂, kam pH, zyada garmi) O₂ chhor kar gehra surkh deoxyhaemoglobin ban jata hai.
3. Taqreeban 20% CO₂ apni globin chains par le jata hai, aur H⁺ pakar kar tissues ko O₂ dene mein madad karta hai.
Isi wajah se blood fi litre 200 mL O₂ le jata hai, jab ke plasma sirf 3 mL ghol sakta hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Describe the causes, symptoms and treatment of sinusitis.
Sinusitis ki wajuhaat, alamaat aur ilaaj bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Sinusitis sinuses (naak ke ird gird hawa se bhare chaar jore khane: aankhon ke neeche, oopar, darmiyan aur peeche) ki andar wali tah ki soojan (inflammation) hai. Yeh upper respiratory tract ki infection hai; acute (7-10 din) ya chronic (12 hafte se zyada) ho sakti hai.
Wajuhaat: zyada tar viruses; kuch bacteria; bohat kam fungi.
Alamaat: bukhar, band naak, peep jaisa naak ka paani, soonghne ki taaqat khatam, chehre mein dard, balgham ka naak ke peeche se gale mein girne ka ehsas, aur sar dard jo jhukne par barh jata hai.
Ilaaj:
1. Virus wali sinusitis aam tor par antibiotics ke baghair theek ho jati hai.
2. Bacteria wali: antibiotics ya sulpha drugs.
3. Nebulization soojan kam karti hai aur jaldi theek karti hai.
4. Chronic ya baar baar hone wali: nasal surgery jis mein germs aur mucus nikale jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
6. Describe the causes, symptoms and treatment of pneumonia and pulmonary tuberculosis.
Pneumonia aur pulmonary tuberculosis ki wajuhaat, alamaat aur ilaaj bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Pneumonia
Aik acute (achanak) saans ki infection jis mein aik ya dono phephron ke alveoli soojh kar peep aur paani se bhar jate hain; saans lena dardnaak aur O₂ kam ho jati hai. Duniya bhar mein bachon ki maut ki sab se bari infectious wajah hai.
Wajuhaat: zyada tar bacteria (khaas tor par Streptococcus pneumoniae) ya viruses (maslan human rhinovirus); kabhi kabhi fungi.
Alamaat: balgham wali khansi, saans phoolna, seene mein dard, bukhar, jild ka neela hona, bhook na lagna, dil ki tez dharkan (kitab mein "high heat rate" chhapa hai, matlab high heart rate) aur thakan.
Ilaaj: bacteria wale pneumonia ke liye khaas antibiotics; bukhar aur dard ke liye analgesics (dard kam karne wali dawa); vaccination kuch qisamon se bachati hai.
Pulmonary tuberculosis
Phephron ki TB; lambi (chronic) aur bohat phailne wali (contagious) infection jo khansi aur chheenk se phailti hai.
Wajah: bacterium Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Yeh phephron mein barh kar tissue aur alveoli ko nuqsan deta hai, chhote surakh (cavities) banta hai; aakhri stage mein respiratory failure ho sakta hai.
Alamaat: khoon wali khansi, aksar shaam ko aane jane wala bukhar, raat ko paseena, wazan kam hona, bhook khatam (anorexia), udaasi (depression), kamzori, khushk khansi, aur pleura ki soojan se seene mein dard.
Ilaaj: kai antibiotics lambe arse (taqreeban 9 mahine) tak baqaidgi se.

blocks.prompt:
7. Describe causes, symptoms and treatment of emphysema.
Emphysema ki wajuhaat, alamaat aur ilaaj bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Emphysema COPD ki aik qisam hai jis mein alveoli ki andar wali deewarein kharab ho kar aakhir phat jati hain. Bohat se chhote khanon ki jagah aik bara khana ban jata hai, is liye gas exchange ki surface kam ho jati hai.
Wajuhaat:
1. Smoking (sab se bari wajah).
2. Lambe arse tak hawa ki aaloodgi (pollution), dhool ya chemical dhuwen mein rehna.
3. Protein alpha-1 antitrypsin ki moroosi (genetic) kami.
Alamaat: saans phoolna, khansi, saans mein seeti (wheezing), thakan aur seene mein jakran.
Ilaaj:
1. Smoking chhorna sab se aham qadam hai, warna bimari tezi se barhti hai.
2. Bronchodilators (nalian kholne wali dawa) aur inhaled steroids.
3. Oxygen therapy.
4. Pulmonary rehabilitation (phephron ki warzish aur tarbiyat).

blocks.prompt:
1. How does the structure of the alveoli optimize the exchange of gases like oxygen and carbon dioxide?
Alveoli ki banawat oxygen aur carbon dioxide ke exchange ko behtareen kaise banati hai?
blocks.explanation:
1. Bohat bari tadaad (70 crore tak) se surface area bohat zyada.
2. Deewar sirf 0.1 micrometre moti aur geeli, is liye diffusion ka faasla bohat kam aur gases nami mein ghul jati hain.
3. Har alveolus capillaries ke ghane jaal se dhaka hota hai; blood chalta rehta hai, is liye partial pressure ka farq qaim rehta hai.
4. Saans hawa ko badalti rehti hai, andar O₂ zyada aur CO₂ kam rehti hai.
5. Surfactant alveoli ko band hone aur chipakne se rokta hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. How do diseases like chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) affect gaseous exchange efficiency?
COPD jaisi bimariyan gas exchange ki karkardagi par kya asar dalti hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Emphysema mein alveoli ki deewarein phat jati hain, chhote khane kam aur bare ho jate hain, aur diffusion ki surface kam ho jati hai.
2. Chronic bronchitis mein bronchial nalian soojh kar tang ho jati hain aur zyada mucus unhein band karta hai, is liye alveoli tak kam hawa pohanchti hai.
3. Lambi soojan phephron ke tissue ko kharab kar deti hai.
Nateeja: blood mein O₂ kam jati hai aur CO₂ theek se nahi nikalti; saans phoolti hai, thakan aur baar baar infections hoti hain.

blocks.prompt:
3. Can you explain the process of external respiration versus internal respiration in the context of gaseous exchange?
Gas exchange ke hawale se external aur internal respiration ka farq samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: External respiration phephron mein aur internal respiration tissues mein hoti hai. Dono mein gases zyada partial pressure se kam partial pressure ki taraf diffusion se jati hain.

rows: Alveoli ki hawa aur phephron ki capillaries ke blood ke darmiyan
Jism ki capillaries ke blood aur tissue cells ke darmiyan
Alveoli mein PO₂ zyada (105 mm Hg), O₂ blood mein jati hai

blocks.prompt:
4. How does the transport of like oxygen in the bloodstream support cellular respiration?
(Sahi parhein: How does the transport of gases like oxygen ...) Blood mein oxygen jaisi gases ka transport cellular respiration ki kaise madad karta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Cellular respiration (glycolysis, Krebs cycle, electron transport chain) O₂ istemal kar ke aur CO₂ bana kar khoraak se energy nikalti hai.
1. Haemoglobin phephron se O₂ le kar har cell tak pohanchata hai; O₂ electron transport chain ka aakhri electron acceptor (lene wala) hai, is liye ATP banta rehta hai.
2. Cells zyada kaam karein (exercise, kam pH, zyada garmi) to zyada O₂ chhorti hai, yani zaroorat ke mutabiq supply.
3. Blood CO₂ (zyada tar bicarbonate) wapas le jata hai, is liye woh jama nahi hoti aur pH qaim rehta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "transport of like oxygen" chhapa hai, "gases" reh gaya hai. Sahi: "the transport of gases like oxygen in the bloodstream".

blocks.prompt:
5. What are the environmental factors that can influence gaseous exchange in humans?
Insaanon mein gas exchange par asar dalne wale mahol ke factors kya hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Bulandi (altitude): oonchai par hawa ka pressure kam hota hai, blood mein kam O₂ jati hai aur saans mushkil hoti hai (chapter se).
2. Hawa ki aaloodgi, dhool aur chemical dhuwen: COPD, chronic bronchitis aur emphysema.
3. Tambaku ka dhuwan: COPD aur emphysema ki bari wajah.
4. Carbon monoxide (band kamre mein gas heater): haemoglobin se mazbooti se jur kar O₂ ka transport rokti hai.
5. Bheer wali jagahon par droplets se phailne wale germs (pneumonia, TB).
6. (Chapter se bahar) Bohat thandi, khushk ya nam hawa aur zyada garmi nalion ko chhed sakti hai ya saans ki raftaar badal sakti hai.
